title: ABS Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, 2021: Statistical Areas Level 1 in a box, generalised boundaries
provider: Australian Bureau of Statistics, its ArcGIS REST service ASGS2021/SA1 (layer 1, SA1_GEN: the generalised boundaries), queried by a box
credit: ASGS Edition 3: Australian Bureau of Statistics, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the service's copyright text: 'Unless otherwise noted, content is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)'; checked 2026-11-05)
citation: Australian Bureau of Statistics (2021), Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3, https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/standards/australian-statistical-geography-standard-asgs-edition-3 ; the service https://geo.abs.gov.au/arcgis/rest/services/ASGS2021/SA1/MapServer
format: GeoJSON (WGS 84, outSR 4326): one feature an SA1, with sa1_code_2021 (the key of the Census's tables), sa2_code_2021 and sa2_name_2021, sa3_name_2021 and area_albers_sqkm; its polygon, generalised by the ABS for display.
coverage: The SA1s whose boundaries meet the box, by default about the City of Melbourne, -37.86 to -37.77 S and 144.88 to 145.00 E (956 SA1s on 2026-11-05; the service returns at most 2,000 a request).

south.description: southern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

west.description: western edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

north.description: northern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

east.description: eastern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

city-of-melbourne.description: The SA1s about the City of Melbourne (about 2 MB)
